difficulty_policy.authoritative_gate: openai/gpt-5-nano generic agent, three independent attempts; retain at 0/3 or 1/3 correct, replace at 2/3 or 3/3 correct
difficulty_policy.hard: at least one semantic spec mutation, two reasoning dimensions, score >= 22
difficulty_policy.expert: at least two composed nonredundant spec mutations including surface camouflage, three reasoning dimensions, score >= 40
difficulty_policy.release_rule: a planned tier is not gold until every required certificate and anti-shortcut audit passes
